races.title: State House, District 24
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Dante Pittman
cands.bio: Democrat who has represented North Carolina House District 24 (Wilson and Nash Counties) since January 2025. A Wilson native and UNC-Chapel Hill graduate (2018), he is a captain in the National Guard. He has worked as a grant manager, as human relations director for the City of Wilson, and as a grant writer for Barton College.

endorsements.text: 2026 voter-guide recommendations listed by Ballotpedia include States Win, The Next 50 and Work For Democracy.
In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey he listed VoteVets, Run for Something, Carolina Forward and Work for Democracy as endorsers. This is self-reported.

cands.gaps: We found no roll-call records or sponsored-bill records we could read, so his legislative actions are documented only through his own campaign statements. We found no stated positions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, immigration enforcement or H-1B visas, policing, gun laws, or abortion. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey. We found no reporting on controversies and no documented foreign ties. His campaign site mentions a Wilson Times article, but we could not read it.

local.label: Roots 100: Ballotpedia says he was born in Wilson, NC, and Wikipedia and his campaign site say he is a Wilson County native who graduated from Wilson County Schools (Fike High School) and came home after UNC-Chapel Hill.

land.label: 1 documented position for data centers or more development

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: He has served in the NC House since January 2025 (one term). Before that he was a grant manager and human relations director for the City of Wilson, and he is now a grant writer at Barton College. He is also a National Guard captain.
qual.why: He has legislative service, though only one term, and a career in grants management and city government, which is close to budget and policy work. His many nonprofit and advisory board seats, and his past chairing of the county Democratic Party and the county social services board, were not counted.

land_positions.quote_or_summary: His campaign site says North Carolina needs to 'expand our housing options' by expanding the supply of homes. It also says he has advocated for industry expansion in the region (naming Johnson & Johnson) and wants to recruit major corporations to Wilson County.

cands.name: Blake Boykin
cands.bio: Republican candidate for North Carolina House District 24, which includes Wilson County. Member of the Wilson County Schools board, District 6, since 2020. Advanced from a canceled 2026 Republican primary and lost the general election to incumbent Dante Pittman (D).
cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he grew up, or when he moved to North Carolina. We found no occupation or career history apart from his Wilson County Schools board seat. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and we found no campaign website statements, interviews or questionnaires on any policy issue. We found no documented positions on data centers or development, no endorsements, no controversies and no foreign ties. We also found no record of school board votes or actions that bear on the issues voters ask about.
